title: Shortest Distance in a Plane
goal: Find the shortest Euclidean distance between distinct planar points, rounded to two decimals.
strategy: Compare each unordered pair once using squared distance. Keep the smallest squared value, then take one square root and round only the final result.

Several equal shortest distances are harmless
